question: Does removing the imposed 0.5 m far-column hydrostatic uplift and initializing every MODFLOW cell at the same head as its SWAP hydrostatic profile allow an ordinary first coupled window to accept? If yes, can a subsequent bounded window accept simple uniform rainfall/recharge while preserving the existing transaction and mass gates?
interpretation: C2 is a control for the effect of matching the far-column MODFLOW and SWAP hydrostatic heads. C0/C1 retain their registered 0.5 m far-column uplift as an experimental perturbation; whether it represents the intended drain-down challenge or an initial-condition mismatch remains unresolved. C2 does not replace or repair C0/C1.

initial_state.initial_drain_flow: zero at hydrostatic equilibrium; verify from native budget

forcing_sequence.purpose: Require an ordinary accepted transaction at the exactly matched hydrostatic origin before applying forcing.
Test vertical SWAP input followed by MODFLOW lateral redistribution to the sole left drain.

predictor.scope: Use only at its matching hydrostatic origin; recompute after every accepted state. Do not extrapolate across a head change or reuse the heuristic -100 day inverse slope.

accounting.whole_domain_balance: integrated precipitation - ET - runoff - drain_outflow = delta_SWAP_storage; interface exchange is internal and is not counted twice
accounting.publication: MODFLOW finalizes once, then SWAP commits once, then interface ledger commits once; reject must preserve committed state and accepted XOLD

required_observations: first trial heads and q(H) origin
SWAP storage, MODFLOW heads and native drain budget
far-to-near head response and internal face flows
fresh-process replay identity and rejected-state preservation

decision_rules.C2a_reject: Retain as negative. Initial-head mismatch alone is not established as the cause; keep RESP01 open and trace backend rejection.
decision_rules.C2a_accept_C2b_reject: Hydrostatic transaction is demonstrated, but simple-forcing coupling is not qualified; diagnose flux sign, forcing binding, temporal error and mass terms without changing gates.
decision_rules.C2a_and_C2b_accept: Qualify only these bounded windows after all frozen head, flux, replay, ownership and mass checks pass. Do not infer timestep convergence, Hupsel readiness, restart qualification or canonical admission.
decision_rules.repeated_identical_forcing_runs: Require fresh-process JSON identity for the same executable/source and initial state.

execution_prerequisites.research_fixture: Set C1 SWAP columns 1..50 and MODFLOW cells 1..50 to the same -1.0 m total-head equilibrium; remove only the far-column +0.5 m uplift.
execution_prerequisites.forcing_harness: Expose zero-rain C2a and 1 mm/day precipitation C2b through the actual SWAP surface forcing path; keep ET, roots, runoff configuration and all coupling semantics explicit.
execution_prerequisites.source_binding: Checkout the exact canonical commit above, overlay only the preregistered research grid stub, compile the C2 context override, and verify every compiled src/ blob against that canonical checkout before executing.

claim_ceiling: Research-only bounded first-window result; no C0/C1 repair, Hupsel qualification, full benchmark qualification or canonical admission.

source_binding.compiled_src_validation: every compiled src/ git blob must equal HEAD:path in that exact checkout

pre_execution_attempt.classification: model not executed; C2 fixture compiled but manifest path was literal in quoted heredoc

pre_execution_attempt_retry.classification: model not executed; fixture compiled but work-branch source blobs did not match the preregistered canonical manifest; workflow corrected to build on exact canonical checkout
